verdict.rationale: Power efficiency is a fair question for a discrete GPU, but the pack has no documented power envelope (TDP, board power, or power limits) for the RTX 5080. The only independent performance-per-watt comment says the 4080 Super appears to beat the 5080 on that measure, which does not show the 5080 is power-efficient under sustained loads. The vendor's "studio-class power and efficiency" line is generic marketing with no figures, so the story is unsupported.
